grounding.claim: Auth surface 'Local map server HTTP listener' is protected by: tools/coyodex/viewer/serve.py:734
grounding.note: The listener is constructed with a hardcoded 127.0.0.1 bind address (no host option anywhere in serve()/main()), so the socket is genuinely loopback-only.

grounding.claim: Auth surface 'DNS-rebinding guard on every request' is protected by: tools/coyodex/viewer/serve.py:512
grounding.note: Line 512 is the first statement of do_GET and rejects any non-loopback Host with 403 (do_POST repeats it at line 532, and no other verb is implemented, so every served request passes it) — an absent Host is deliberately allowed, which is a non-browser bypass only.

grounding.claim: Auth surface 'State-changing POST endpoints (add / forget / reorder a project)' is protected by: tools/coyodex/viewer/serve.py:535
grounding.note: The custom-header CSRF check runs before any routing in do_POST, and since the server implements no OPTIONS handler a cross-origin preflight for X-Coyodex cannot succeed.

grounding.claim: Auth surface 'Source file read at the pinned commit (/p/<slug>/api/src)' is protected by: tools/coyodex/viewer/serve.py:631
grounding.note: The src route rejects the query path with 400 before any git call when _safe_rel fails (no leading '/', no backslash, no NUL, no '..' component), and git_show/git_blob_size re-check it at lines 202 and 221.

grounding.claim: Auth surface 'Working-tree file read (/p/<slug>/api/src?at=WORKTREE)' is protected by: tools/coyodex/viewer/serve.py:275
grounding.note: worktree_read (reached from the src route at line 637) resolves the path with strict realpath and returns None unless it stays inside the resolved repo root and contains no .git component, so a symlink escape is caught after resolution, not before.

grounding.claim: Auth surface 'Git argument injection through a commit value' is protected by: tools/coyodex/viewer/serve.py:643
grounding.note: The at= value is rejected with 400 unless it fullmatches a bare 7-64 hex SHA, so a leading dash can never reach git's argv on this route.

grounding.claim: Auth surface 'Git argument injection through a user-supplied ref' is protected by: tools/coyodex/viewer/serve.py:254
grounding.note: The protection is real but NOT at the anchored line: serve.py's _safe_ref/resolve_ref is only ever called with the map's own commit (serve.py:293), while the user-supplied base/target refs of /api/impact and /api/impactsrcdiff are gated by impact_git.resolve_ref, whose regex forces a leading alphanumeric and which passes --end-of-options.

grounding.claim: Auth surface 'Filesystem browser used to pick a project folder (/api/browse)' is protected by: tools/coyodex/viewer/serve.py:565
grounding.note: The anchored line is the listing itself (return self._json(list_dirs(base))) and there is no containment check anywhere on this route — any path the user types is expanduser()/resolve()d and listed, the only preceding test being 'is it a directory'; the code even states there is no privilege boundary here (line 441).

grounding.claim: Auth surface 'Adding a project folder to the served set (/api/open)' is protected by: tools/coyodex/viewer/serve.py:574
grounding.note: _open rejects with 400 unless the folder actually contains a .coyodex/ directory (after absolute-path and is_dir checks at 571-573), so an arbitrary folder cannot be added to the served set.

grounding.claim: Auth surface 'Shared frontend asset route (/static/<name>)' is protected by: tools/coyodex/viewer/serve.py:702
grounding.note: The route serves only names present in the exact-name _STATIC_FILES dict and 404s otherwise, and the name is a single already-unquoted path segment, so '../serve.py' simply misses the dict.

grounding.claim: Auth surface 'Editor hand-off URI built from a user-supplied template' is protected by: tools/coyodex/viewer/viewer.js:5976
grounding.note: editorUri returns null unless the scheme of the fully-built URI is in ALLOWED_OPEN_SCHEMES (line 5914), and the only caller of fireUri (line 6021) fires exclusively that checked value, so a javascript:/data: custom template cannot reach the <a href>.

grounding.claim: Auth surface 'Third-party scripts executed inside the viewer page' is protected by: tools/coyodex/viewer/viewer.html:17
grounding.note: Both CDN <script> tags are version-pinned and carry a real sha384 integrity attribute plus crossorigin=anonymous (line 17 for svg-pan-zoom, line 20 for mermaid), which the browser enforces; there is no CSP, so SRI is the whole protection.

grounding.claim: Auth surface 'Map-supplied text rendered into diagram labels' is protected by: tools/coyodex/viewer/gen_viewer.py:97
grounding.note: _safe_label's replacement chain (97-107) neutralises quote/backtick/brackets/braces/pipe and, crucially, < and > — which matters because the viewer initialises mermaid with securityLevel 'loose' (viewer.js:131) — and it is applied at ~25 label call sites, with _edge_label covering pipe labels.

grounding.claim: Auth surface 'Request body size on the POST endpoints' is protected by: tools/coyodex/viewer/serve.py:689
grounding.note: _read_json refuses to read anything with a non-positive or >64 KB Content-Length before touching rfile, and it is the single body reader for all three POST endpoints (line 539).
